observations.observation: NRL.com now reports Cronulla is preparing to welcome back 2026 try-assist leader Braydon Trindall for the elimination final. This upgrades the return signal from secondary conditional reporting to official NRL current reporting, but it is not an official team-list confirmation. Official judiciary reporting still lists Michael Gabrael with a Grade 3 Careless High Tackle charge, plea TBC, carrying 2-3 matches.
observations.decision_effect: Material positive Sharks spine-continuity signal strengthened by official NRL reporting; centre-depth risk remains unresolved through Gabrael.
observations.tip_effect: Sharks retained at 64%; no confidence uplift until official selection and Cowboys judiciary state are resolved.

observations.observation: Official NRL judiciary reporting confirms Reuben Cotter pleaded not guilty to the Grade 2 Careless High Tackle charge and will front the judiciary on Tuesday night. A not-guilty finding makes him available for the Sharks elimination final; a guilty finding results in a two-match suspension.
observations.decision_effect: Material Cowboys middle-continuity uncertainty remains active until the judiciary outcome is verified.

observations.player: Isaah Yeo / Mitch Kenny / Scott Sorensen
observations.observation: Isaah Yeo and Mitch Kenny completed successful Round 27 returns; Scott Sorensen is expected back for Week 1 pending official selection.

observations.player: James Tedesco / Daly Cherry-Evans / Victor Radley / Angus Crichton / senior cohort
observations.observation: The Roosters are set to restore a large senior cohort rested in Round 27, including James Tedesco, Daly Cherry-Evans and Victor Radley. Angus Crichton remains a selection possibility rather than verified. Sam Walker remains unlikely before a potential preliminary final. At the official Finals launch, Tedesco explicitly identified the Roosters' Round 24 win over Penrith as their template: completion, field position, Daly Cherry-Evans controlling the game with his kicking, then attacking rather than playing too safely.
observations.decision_effect: Strengthened evidence-supported Roosters counter-case and matchup memory. Round 27 remains heavily down-weighted because of deliberate rest; Round 24 provides a more representative structural matchup reference.
observations.tip_effect: Panthers retained at 73%; no confidence chase.
